method.name: RetypeShared
method.brief: Allocate zeroed frames that a hypervisor or DMA device can access.
method.description: Allocates contiguous frames from the source RAM untyped using its normal watermark. Each frame has a separate capability. Stop DMA before deleting its last capability or revoking the source. Final deletion restores private, zeroed RAM. SEL4_BOOTINFO_HEADER_SHARED_DMA indicates that DMA requires shared frames.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: Guest memory sharing is unavailable.

error.name: seL4_InvalidCapability
error.description: The source does not designate shareable RAM.

error.name: seL4_InvalidArgument
error.description: The requested frame size is unsupported.

error.name: seL4_TruncatedMessage
error.description: A required argument or destination root is missing.

error.name: seL4_RangeError
error.description: The destination window is invalid or the request exceeds 256 frames or 2 MiB.

error.name: seL4_NotEnoughMemory
error.description: The aligned frames do not fit in the remaining RAM.

error.name: seL4_DeleteFirst
error.description: A destination slot is occupied.

error.name: seL4_FailedLookup
error.description: The destination CNode could not be resolved.

interface.name: seL4_X64_PML4
interface.cap_description: Capability to the VSpace root (PML4) being operated on.

method.name: FrameBatch
method.brief: Copy-and-map, remap or delete frame capabilities in this address space, many in one call.
method.description: The header (message word 0) is op (bits 0-1: 1 copy-and-map, 2 remap, 3 delete), the number of entries (bits 8-15), the depth of every CPtr (bits 16-22, 1 to 64), the seL4_CapRights mask the mappings get (bits 24-27), the seL4_CapRights mask a copy keeps (bits 28-31), the VM attributes, seL4_X86_DeferFlush included (bits 32-36), and the flag that defers the TLB invalidation of deletes (bit 40); the other bits are reserved (zero). The entries follow, all of the header's op. Copy-and-map, three words (source CPtr, destination CPtr, vaddr): copy the frame capability, masked with the copy rights, into the empty destination slot and map it at vaddr; a failure leaves neither. Remap, two words (CPtr, vaddr): map the frame capability, which is unmapped or already maps vaddr in this address space. Delete, one word (CPtr): delete the frame capability; an empty slot is no error. With the defer flag, a deleted frame mapped in this address space (other than a device frame) is unmapped without its own invalidation, and the call invalidates the address space once, before it returns. Extra capability 0 is the CNode the CPtrs are looked up in; extra capability 1, if given, is the destination CNode of copies. The entries run in order and the call stops at the first that fails; a Call's reply is (entries done, the seL4_Error of the failing entry or 0).

param.name: header
param.description: Op, count, depth, rights, attributes and flags

interface.name: seL4_X86_TdxControl
interface.cap_description: Intel TDX attestation control capability, in root CNode slot seL4_CapX86TdxControl of a TDX guest.

method.name: GetReport
method.brief: Write this TD's 1024-byte TDREPORT, bound to 64 bytes of report data.
method.description: Runs TDG.MR.REPORT. On success the report is in the first 1024 bytes of the frame. A nonzero tdx_status is the TDX module's completion status; the frame is then unchanged.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: This is not a TDX guest.

error.name: seL4_InvalidCapability
error.description: report_frame is not a writable private 4 KiB frame.

error.name: seL4_TruncatedMessage
error.description: A required argument or the frame capability is missing.

method.name: ExtendRTMR
method.brief: Extend a runtime measurement register with a SHA-384 digest.
method.description: Runs TDG.MR.RTMR.EXTEND. A nonzero tdx_status is the TDX module's completion status.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: This is not a TDX guest.

error.name: seL4_InvalidArgument
error.description: rtmr_index is above 3.

error.name: seL4_TruncatedMessage
error.description: A required argument is missing.

method.name: GetQuote
method.brief: Ask the VMM to turn the TDREPORT in a shared buffer into a quote.
method.description: Runs TDG.VP.VMCALL<GetQuote> on the frame, which must come from RetypeShared. The call does not block: the VMM updates the buffer's status field when the quote is ready.

param.name: shared_frame
param.description: A writable shared 4 KiB or 2 MiB frame

param.name: buf_len
param.description: Buffer length: a multiple of 4096, at most the frame's size

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: This is not a TDX guest.

error.name: seL4_InvalidCapability
error.description: shared_frame is not a writable frame from RetypeShared.

error.name: seL4_InvalidArgument
error.description: buf_len is not a nonzero multiple of 4096 within the frame.

error.name: seL4_TruncatedMessage
error.description: A required argument or the frame capability is missing.

interface.name: seL4_IRQControl
interface.cap_description: An IRQControl capability. This gives you the authority to make this call.

method.name: GetMSI
method.brief: Create an IRQ handler capability for MSIs of a PCI function through the GICv3 ITS.
method.description: Maps event `event` of device `device` (its PCI requester ID) to the kernel's LPI number `irq` and routes it to core `target`. The device raises it by writing `event` to the doorbell that SEL4_BOOTINFO_HEADER_AARCH64_MSI_INFO gives, whose numbers bound the arguments. Deleting the handler unmaps the event. LPIs are edge triggered and are not masked between their signal and IRQHandler_Ack.

param.name: device
param.description: The device ID (PCI requester ID), below num_devices.

param.name: event
param.description: The event ID the device writes, below num_events.

param.name: root
param.description: CPtr to the CNode that forms the root of the destination CSpace. Must be at a depth equivalent to the wordsize.

param.name: index
param.description: CPtr to the destination slot. Resolved from the root of the destination CSpace.

param.name: depth
param.description: Number of bits of index to resolve to find the destination slot.

param.name: target
param.description: The core the interrupt goes to.

error.name: seL4_IllegalOperation
error.description: The kernel drives no ITS, or the device has no ITS table left.

error.name: seL4_RangeError
error.description: The irq is not below num_lpis.

error.name: seL4_InvalidArgument
error.description: The device, the event (or the event is mapped already) or the target is invalid.

error.name: seL4_RevokeFirst
error.description: An IRQ handler for irq exists.

error.name: seL4_TruncatedMessage
error.description: A required argument or the destination root is missing.

error.name: seL4_DeleteFirst
error.description: The destination slot contains a capability.

error.name: seL4_FailedLookup
error.description: The destination slot could not be resolved.
